title: MDM Migration Readiness Assessment & Wave Planning
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (vendor-neutral pre-migration assessment + wave/risk planning across an MDM estate; discovery and planning, sells ahead of execution).
hook: Know exactly what you're migrating — before you touch a single device
problem: Most MDM migrations fail in planning, not execution: nobody has a clean inventory, the waves aren't thought through, and the risks surface mid-cutover. This solution is a vendor-neutral MDM migration readiness assessment and wave plan — inventory the current estate (devices, OS mix, apps, profiles, enrollment types), score readiness and risk, and produce a sequenced wave plan so the actual migration runs to a script instead of by surprise.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the readiness-assessment model, what to inventory (devices, OS/platform mix, apps, profiles, compliance, enrollment types, dependencies), readiness/risk scoring, and how the wave plan is built.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (read access to the current MDM, an inventory/export method, target-platform context, stakeholder input) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory the estate, classify and score readiness/risk, identify dependencies and blockers, design sequenced waves with entry/exit criteria, produce the plan, then validate it against a pilot wave.
5 PowerShell scripts — estate inventory discovery, data-completeness validation, a readiness/risk and wave-plan report, safe remediation of inventory gaps, and a wave/cohort group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A vendor-neutral MDM migration readiness assessment and wave plan — inventory the estate, score readiness and risk, and produce a sequenced wave plan so the migration runs to a script instead of by surprise. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A vendor-neutral MDM migration readiness assessment and wave plan — inventory the estate, score readiness and risk, and produce a sequenced wave plan so the migration runs to a script instead of by surprise.
meta_title: MDM Migration Readiness Assessment & Wave Planning
meta_description: Assess MDM migration readiness and plan waves: estate inventory, readiness/risk scoring, dependency analysis, and a sequenced wave plan with entry/exit criteria. Self-guided, tested steps and scripts.
bottom_line: A clear-eyed picture of exactly what you're migrating and in what order — estate inventoried, readiness and risk scored, and a sequenced wave plan with entry/exit criteria — so the migration runs to a script, validated against a pilot wave before you scale.
